description:
Xiaomi on-device AI inference engine (HyperOS/MIUI). Runs many ML models (OCR, translation, etc.) in isolated per-model processes. 
Embeds Xiaomi's OneTrack SDK, which collects OAID, android_id, device fingerprint, region, network type, and per-event usage data, then uploads it encrypted to tracking.*.miui.com. 
Also embeds XCrash for crash reporting. Downloads AI model updates silently via Android DownloadManager (probably has to do with AI Core). 
Removing probably breaks HyperOS AI features (I haven't tested) but does not affect core phone, SMS, or data functions.
